title: Early Requests for Reinstatement of Summit Miles
content:
**Rule.** In the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program, the prompt-request treatment sets the fee to pay for a reinstatement from the band fee, before any amount is taken off it or added to it. It follows how promptly the reinstatement is requested, counted in calendar days from the date of the forfeiture entry to the day of the reinstatement.

- A request up to 30 days after the forfeiture: the fee to pay is set at a flat 50 USD, whatever band the forfeiture's miles fall in.
- A request more than 30 and up to 90 days after the forfeiture: the fee to pay is set at 75 percent of the band fee, rounded up to the whole dollar.
- A later request: the fee to pay is kept at the band fee.

### Input, judgement, output (hypothetical)

| Days from the forfeiture entry | Band fee (USD) | Fee to pay set by this rule (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | 400 | 50 |
| 31 | 250 | 188 (75 percent is 187.50, rounded up) |
| 31 | 150 | 113 (75 percent is 112.50, rounded up) |
| 90 | 400 | 300 |
| 91 | 250 | 250 |

Day 30 is still inside the flat-fee span; day 90 is still inside the 75 percent span.
